Expands software footprint and recurring revenue potential within Entra portfolio.
Brings established customer base; potential cross-sell into Entra vCMTS/RPDs.
Scale data enhances AI analytics; strengthens operator stickiness.
Lowers adoption friction; broadens addressable market beyond Vecima hardware.
Frames long-term market opportunity including PNM/OSS software.

This is a strategic tuck-in expanding Vecima’s AI-driven broadband software and recurring revenue base. For a larger catalyst, watch for disclosed financial terms, customer wins, and revenue growth or margin mix shifts attributed to CableDiag.
